description: Optimal settlement execution window analysis for a specific cross-border payment over the next 72 hours. Generates 18 × 4-hour time slots and scores each by composite risk: corridor stability, FX session liquidity, cascade level decay/growth based on macro outlook, weekend/off-hours penalty, and counterparty ESG tier (if LEI provided). Returns a ranked window schedule with OPTIMAL / GOOD / ACCEPTABLE / AVOID classification per slot, a best-window recommendation, and large-amount splitting guidance for settlements ≥ $5M. Use this before scheduling large cross-border settlements to minimize execution risk.

amount.description: Settlement amount (default 1,000,000). Used for large-amount guidance ≥$5M.

currency.description: Currency of the amount (defaults to from).

lei.description: Optional 20-char GLEIF LEI of counterparty — fetches live ESG tier to apply counterparty risk penalty.

name: stability.settlement_window

recommendation.description: bestWindow (ISO datetime), bestScore, optimalCount, goodCount, summary, largeAmountNote

windows.description: 18 × 4-hour slots: startUtc, endUtc, compositeScore, tier, components, recommendation, rationale
